job.title: Car Carrier Driver | Electric Fleet | Melbourne
job.description:
About AIM Recruitment Solutions
AIM Recruitment Solutions is a specialist recruitment agency supporting leading organisations across Australia. With nearly 20 years of industry experience, we connect skilled professionals with reputable employers across transport, logistics, warehousing and industrial sectors.
We are excited to once again be partnering with a new and innovative transport operator that is doing things differently.

Our client is a new generation of trucking company, operating an entire fleet of fully electric prime movers powered by wholesale renewable energy. They are gearing up to take on the transport industry in a way we haven't seen before – and as their operations continue to expand, we are now looking for an experienced Car Carrier Driver to help establish their Victorian operation.

About the Role
We are seeking an experienced and highly reliable Car Carrier Driver to commence mid-October.
Operating between Derrimut and Laverton through to Kilsyth, you will be responsible for safely transporting vehicles while representing our client professionally across their Victorian operation.

This is a particularly important position within the business. As our client does not currently operate from an established Victorian site, we need someone who is confident working autonomously, can take ownership of their day and doesn't require constant supervision.

If you have proven car carrier experience and like the idea of joining an innovative transport company as it establishes its presence in Victoria, this could be an exciting opportunity.
Hours of Work 6:00am to approximately 4:00pm–4:30pm

Key Responsibilities
  • Safely operate a car carrier and transport vehicles between locations
  • Complete regular runs between Derrimut, Laverton and Kilsyth
  • Safely load, secure, transport and unload vehicles
  • Conduct pre-start and vehicle safety inspections
  • Ensure vehicles are transported without damage and handled with care
  • Complete required transport and delivery documentation
  • Plan and manage your daily workload and movements efficiently
  • Communicate professionally with customers and operational contacts
  • Maintain compliance with road transport, fatigue management and Chain of Responsibility requirements
  • Work autonomously and take ownership of the Victorian operation
  • Represent the business professionally at all times
About You – To be successful, you will have:
  • Previous car carrier experience – essential
  • Appropriate current heavy vehicle driver's licence
  • Demonstrated experience safely loading and unloading vehicles
  • Strong understanding of load restraint and vehicle transportation requirements
  • Confidence working independently with minimal supervision
  • Excellent time management and organisational skills
  • Strong communication and customer service skills
  • A professional and reliable approach to your work
  • Strong commitment to safety and compliance
  • Good knowledge of Melbourne's western and eastern transport corridors
  • Ability to commence from mid-October
Above all, we are looking for someone who can take ownership of the role. You will be the person on the ground representing this growing operation in Victoria, so reliability, communication and initiative will be just as important as your driving experience.

What’s On Offer
  • Opportunity to work with an exciting new transport operator
  • Drive as part of a fully electric heavy vehicle fleet
  • Be involved in establishing the company's Victorian operation
  • Consistent daytime hours – approximately 6:00am–4:00/4:30pm
  • Opportunity to work autonomously and manage your own operation
  • Innovative business bringing something genuinely different to Australia's transport industry
  • Ongoing support from AIM Recruitment Solutions
How to Apply
If you're an experienced Car Carrier Driver looking for something a little different from the traditional transport operation, we want to hear from you.

job.title: Delivery Driver / Warehouse Storeperson
job.description:
About AIM Recruitment Solutions
AIM Recruitment Solutions is a specialist recruitment agency with nearly 20 years of industry experience, connecting quality candidates with reputable employers across Australia. We pride ourselves on providing genuine opportunities and ongoing support throughout the recruitment process.

About the Role
We are currently partnering with an established business to recruit a reliable and customer-focused Delivery Driver / Warehouse Storeperson to join their Brisbane-based team.
This is a varied, hands-on position combining local deliveries, customer service and general warehouse duties. Reporting to the Store Supervisor, you will spend your day completing deliveries across Brisbane while also assisting with picking orders, unpacking stock and general warehouse operations.
You will generally complete 3–4 delivery runs per day, with multiple customer deliveries on each run, using a company-supplied light commercial van.
This is an ongoing casual opportunity for approximately 3–4 months, with the successful candidate expected to transition into full-time permanent employment at $55,300 per annum once established in the role.
Hours: Monday to Friday, 8:00am–4:30pm – 38 hours per week.

Key Responsibilities
  • Complete 3–4 local delivery runs each day with multiple drops per run
  • Deliver goods to customers and other branch locations within required timeframes
  • Pick and prepare customer orders
  • Unpack, receive and organise incoming stock
  • Arrange freight and coordinate the delivery of goods
  • Assist with general warehouse duties as required
  • Handle products weighing up to approximately 20kg
  • Respond professionally to customer enquiries at the point of delivery
  • Receive customer payments where required and return these to the Store Supervisor
  • Maintain professional presentation and excellent customer service
  • Ensure the company vehicle and delivery documentation are maintained appropriately
  • Work collaboratively with the warehouse and wider branch team
About You – To be successful, you will have:
  • A current and valid driver's licence allowing you to drive in Queensland – essential
  • Confidence driving a light commercial van throughout Brisbane
  • Good knowledge of Brisbane roads and surrounding areas
  • Previous warehouse, storeperson or delivery experience is highly regarded; however, training can be provided
  • A good level of physical fitness and the ability to safely handle products weighing up to 20kg
  • Basic computer skills
  • Excellent customer service and communication skills
  • Strong time management and the ability to manage multiple deliveries efficiently
  • Ability to work autonomously while remaining part of a wider team
  • Professional presentation and a friendly, approachable manner
  • Strong relationship-building skills with customers and colleagues
  • Reliability and a genuine interest in securing long-term permanent employment
What’s On Offer
  • Monday to Friday – 8:00am–4:30pm
  • Consistent 38-hour working week
  • No weekend work
  • Company vehicle provided for deliveries during working hours
  • Varied role combining driving, customer service and warehouse duties
  • Ongoing casual employment for approximately 3–4 months
  • Opportunity to transition to full-time permanent employment
  • $55,300 per annum once successfully converted to permanent
  • Training available for the right candidate
  • Supportive and established team environment
  • Long-term career opportunity for someone looking for stability
Location Considerations
Due to the location of the branch and associated Brisbane toll costs, this opportunity may particularly suit candidates who live on the same side of Brisbane as the workplace or have convenient access to the area.

If you are a reliable and physically fit driver who enjoys customer interaction and doesn't mind rolling up your sleeves in the warehouse, we would love to hear from you.
